JMP offers a 30-day free trial for anyone, anywhere. Go to https://www.jmp.com/scishow  to see the benefits of visual statistics for yourself. Check out WildTrack’s story here: https://www.jmp.com/wildtrack 

Thousands of years ago, some people carved a huge camel into a rock in the Arabian peninsula. Not only has that carving doubled the amount of time we think humans were living in the region… it might also help crack a prehistoric climate mystery.

Hosted by: Savannah Geary (they/them)
